contribution_types.description: Liquidity: COINLIST SEED SPRING 2022 BATCH: Are you working on a new crypto startup? We want to hear from you! CoinList is accepting applications from entrepreneurs that are interested in participating in the Spring 2022 batch of the CoinList Seed program. Apply by May 1, 11:59pm PT.

Governance: TSD earned through contribution should be vested via in game activity to be unlocked for transfer to personal wallet. 

This helps reduce dumping of TSD Tokens on the open market and shifts us away from time based vesting which is essentially meaningless while stabilizing the price of TSD on the exchanges once they are listed.

The initial 1000TSD can be transferred to personal wallets without in-game activity based vesting

Finalized agreement with DAOversal group to contribute 14,000TSD worth of manpower effort per month
    - Engineering 
    - Design
    - Marketing
    - Community Management

https://truesight.me/rubric

Proposed Trading Strategy: Crypto entry signal when red line crosses blackline on the To The Moon chart is a good time to enter into BTC

https://truesight.me/large_crypto_spikes
Social Recognition is a very strong motivator

Suggested to focus on the following

- bring in another relevant high profile subject matter experts as core contributor to boost up team profile
- bring in investors willing to park cash
- bring in investors who are Key Opinion Leaders willing to promote our game amongst their own followers

Operations advice
- building the game can come later since it is not rocket science
- the operations team does not need to be the same as the team presented in the deck
Suggested the AI and Knowledge Graphs are very important component while DAO is just for governance

narrative.text: Bing contributed to the DAO across strategy, liquidity, and partnerships from April 2022 to June 2022. Their efforts centered on Build Game strategy, including two full-scale strategies with rollout action plans to grow the DAO and two independent reiterations of pending decision signals. Bing also suggested a fundraising approach for liquidity and secured a successful tie-up with a channel partner in business development.
